messages.subject: example of  Guo and Carlin (2004)
parts:
I'm new to INLA, and am trying to understand the example of  Guo and Carlin (2004)  "Separate and Joint Modeling of Longitudinal and Event Time Data Using Standard Computer Packages",

The first thing i noticed was that they say  cd4+ count should be transformed by taking the square root, which is also evident from the skewed distribution in the datafile. 

Where in the script is the square root applied to the data? also, in figure 3 of the manuscript, the numbers of the graph are the same as the untransformed data, can you explain? 

Thanks!
